images.caption: Backlit grass catches evening light in Pittsburgh, Pa., Aug. 5, 2020.

images.caption: A fire escape cuts across a brick facade in Downtown Pittsburgh, Pa., Oct. 28, 2021.
images.description: A black metal fire escape zigzags up a weathered brick building, framed against windowed office towers in the background.

images.caption: Clouds gather over Pittsburgh's riverfront at sunset, Pittsburgh, Pa., Oct. 28, 2021.
images.description: Purple and blue clouds spread above the river as city lights begin to glow along the shoreline at dusk.
images.alt: Clouds gather over Pittsburgh's riverfront at sunset.
